userStories.title: Solo role filter on the Browse tab
userStories.description: Tank / Healer / DPS toggles on Forever's Browse tab. Ticking roles hides 5-man dungeon listings without an open spot for any ticked role (template 1/1/3, unassigned members count as DPS, full groups always hidden). A 'Showing X of Y (roles)' line shows under the list. Nothing ticked = no filtering. Filter re-applies on every results refresh. Ships with `/openspot debug`, writing each listing's raw member counts, activity, size and verdict into SavedVariables. Stories 1-5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 22, 23, 25, 26.
acceptanceCriteria: Fit evaluates dungeon listings against the 1/1/3 template, OR over ticked roles (unit tests)
Unassigned members count as DPS; full listings never fit (unit tests)
Summary text 'Showing X of Y (Tank, DPS)' (unit tests)
Toggles and counter appear on the Browse tab and hide non-fitting rows (smoke test)
/openspot debug stores a report in OpenSpotDB.report
Search, apply and whisper still go through Blizzard's window

acceptanceCriteria: Raid/other listing with free slots fits for any ticked role; full one does not (unit tests)
Single-player listings hidden while filtering, shown with nothing ticked (unit tests)
Debug report records the fields used to recognise single-player listings

userStories.title: Party mode with pre-filled role counts
userStories.description: In a party the toggles become per-role counts, pre-filled from members' assigned roles and adjustable by hand. A listing fits only if every counted role is open and it has free slots for the whole party. Counts refresh on roster/role changes; leaving the party restores solo ticks. Stories 15-21.
acceptanceCriteria: Counts pre-filled from assigned roles, NONE adds nothing (unit tests)
AND over counts plus free >= party size - 1 (unit tests)
Manual adjustment kept until the roster or roles change (unit tests)
Leaving the party restores solo ticks (unit tests)
Steppers shown in a party, toggles solo (smoke test)

userStories.title: Role badges on member icons
userStories.description: Every member's class icon in a result row carries a small role badge (shield = tank, cross = healer, sword = DPS). Members without a role get no badge and a greyed icon. Shown in every mode. Story 43.
acceptanceCriteria: Each member icon shows a badge for its role (smoke test)

Badge texture checked in game (issue 020)

userStories.title: Recruit mode for a listed party
userStories.description: In a party with its own listing, OpenSpot recruits: the role buttons hold what the party needs (template of the listed activity minus the party's roles, roleless members as DPS; any free slot for raids/other), labelled 'Looking for:', adjustable by hand until roles change. A listing fits when every member fills a missing spot (pairs and trios included, NOROLE as DPS) and it is no bigger than the free slots. The party's own listing is hidden. Summary: 'Recruiting: 3 DPS · Showing X of Y', or 'Your group is full' with nothing filtered. An unlisted party keeps the ADR 0003 behaviour. Stories 44-48, 50, 54; ADR 0006.
acceptanceCriteria: Needs from template minus party roles, NONE as DPS (unit tests)
Hand adjustment kept until roles change (unit tests)
Fit: every member within needs, size within free slots (unit tests)
No needs: nothing filtered, 'Your group is full' (unit tests)
Listed party recruits, unlisted party joins (smoke test)
Own listing hidden (smoke test)
